title: PI(4,5)P2 Imaging Using a GFP Reporter in Living Cells
author: Mariam Alkandari
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: PH-PLCD1-GFP plasmid (Addgene, plasmid #51407; map available at: https://www.addgene.org/51407 ) Reagents
Fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Gibco, catalog number: A
Two-chamber Lab-Tek ® II chambered German coverslip system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, catalog number:
Eppendorf Research ® pipettes, 0.5–10 μL, 10–100 μL, 20–200 μL, 100–1,000 μL (Eppendorf, catalog number:
Biosphere ® plus filter tip, 1000 μL, 200 μL, 100 μL, 10 μL (Sarstedt)

For cell counting, load 10 μL of cell suspension into each chamber of the dual-chambered counting slide and insert into the Bio-Rad automated cell counter, which automatically provides total cell concentration in cells/mL.

steps.title: Seed U2OS cells in chamber slide
steps.instruction: In a Class II biosafety cabinet, seed U2OS cells at 50,000 cells per well in 1 mL of complete DMEM (high glucose) supplemented with 10 % FBS and 1 % antibiotic‑antimycotic in a 2‑well Lab‑Tek II chambered coverslip; do this one day before transfection.

steps.title: Count cells using automated counter
steps.instruction: Load 10 µL of the cell suspension into each chamber of a dual‑chamber counting slide and run the Bio‑Rad automated cell counter to obtain the cell concentration (cells/mL).

steps.title: Replace media with AA‑free DMEM
steps.instruction: On the day of transfection, aspirate the existing medium and add 1 mL per well of antibiotic‑free DMEM (high glucose) supplemented with 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Prepare DNA solution in Opti‑MEM
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, dilute the PH‑PLCD1‑GFP plasmid to contain 0.5 µg DNA in 75 µL Opti‑MEM for each well.

steps.title: Prepare Lipofectamine solution in Opti‑MEM
steps.instruction: In a separate 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, dilute Lipofectamine 2000 to 3 µL per 75 µL Opti‑MEM for each well.

steps.title: Form DNA‑Lipofectamine complexes
steps.instruction: Combine the 75 µL DNA solution (0.5 µg) with the 75 µL Lipofectamine solution (3 µL), gently pipette to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.

steps.title: Add complexes to cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of the DNA‑Lipofectamine complex dropwise to each well, then incubate the cells at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ for 24 h.

steps.title: Refresh media with complete DMEM
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after transfection, replace the transfection medium with fresh complete DMEM (high glucose) containing 10 % FBS and 1 % antibiotic‑antimycotic; incubate another 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Proceed to imaging after 48 h
steps.instruction: At 48 h post‑transfection, cells exhibit >80 % GFP expression and are ready for live‑cell imaging.

steps.title: Configure microscope acquisition settings
steps.instruction: Place the chambered slide in a Zeiss Axio Observer Z.1 spinning‑disk confocal equipped with a temperature‑controlled chamber set to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, ambient O₂ and humidity; set laser intensity to 20 %, exposure to 65 m/s, EM gain to 50, and select isolated cells for imaging.

steps.title: Acquire Z‑stack images
steps.instruction: Using 488 nm excitation and a 517 nm emission filter, acquire a Z‑stack with a constant focal‑plane interval of 0.36 µm; the total imaging period should be 10–20 min with CO₂‑buffered medium and no medium change.

steps.title: Generate orthogonal view and save
steps.instruction: Display the Z‑stack in orthogonal (ortho) mode, center the intersection point on the cell, create the orthogonal image, hide axis lines in the graphics section, and save the file as a TIFF.

steps.title: Open images in FIJI and convert
steps.instruction: Launch FIJI/ImageJ, open each TIFF image, and convert it to 8‑bit or 16‑bit grayscale.

steps.title: Create and manage ROIs
steps.instruction: Open the ROI Manager (Analyze > Tools > ROI Manager), select the rectangle tool, draw the first square ROI, and click Add [t]; enable “Show All” to view all saved ROIs.

steps.title: Place membrane, cytosol, and background ROIs
steps.instruction: Draw three equal squares on the dorsal plasma membrane (apex and left/right positions), three equal squares directly below each membrane ROI in the cytosol, and three random squares outside the cell for background (total nine ROIs).

steps.title: Measure intensities and export data
steps.instruction: With all nine ROIs selected, click Measure in the ROI Manager and export the results (mean fluorescence intensities).

steps.title: Background‑correct and compute ratios
steps.instruction: Calculate the mean intensity of the three background ROIs and subtract this value from each membrane and cytosol intensity; for each of the three membrane ROIs, divide its background‑corrected intensity by the corresponding cytosol ROI intensity, then average the three ratios to obtain the plasma‑membrane‑to‑cytosol ratio for the cell.
